inputs.text: This incident at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday makes clear why strong authority and personal responsibility are essential for holding our society together. An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent moved decisively when a baby stopped breathing in a crowded TSA line with his family. The Department of Homeland Security released video of the agent holding the child and taking immediate action to address the crisis. This is the exact sort of duty and resolve that safeguards families, upholds order, and protects the vulnerable in everyday settings. Agents like this one embody the traditional values of national protection and family security that preserve our children and cultural way of life. We must give full backing to our law enforcement and border institutions rather than allowing progressive attacks to undermine the structures and traditions that defend us.
